name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard clause `Existence(holding_box)` is redundant because the task already requires the agent to be holding the box at the exit (`Response(at_exit, holding_box)` together with `Existence(at_exit)` guarantees at least one occurrence of `holding_box`). Remove this clause; the remaining three clauses correctly capture the task.

texts: Hold the box when at the exit
Pick up the box immediately after it falls
